title: Detailed bow tie
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- left wing shadow -->
  <polygon points='48,48 8,28 8,72 48,52' fill='#7a1535'/>
  <!-- right wing shadow -->
  <polygon points='52,48 92,28 92,72 52,52' fill='#7a1535'/>
  <!-- left wing main -->
  <polygon points='47,46 10,30 10,70 47,54' fill='#d42a5a'/>
  <!-- right wing main -->
  <polygon points='53,46 90,30 90,70 53,54' fill='#d42a5a'/>
  <!-- left wing highlight -->
  <polygon points='46,43 18,32 18,44 46,51' fill='#f25c8a'/>
  <!-- right wing highlight -->
  <polygon points='54,43 82,32 82,44 54,51' fill='#f25c8a'/>
  <!-- left wing crease -->
  <polygon points='42,48 28,38 28,62 42,52' fill='#a81d44'/>
  <!-- right wing crease -->
  <polygon points='58,48 72,38 72,62 58,52' fill='#a81d44'/>
  <!-- left wing inner accent -->
  <polygon points='38,47 30,40 30,60 38,53' fill='#e8487a'/>
  <!-- right wing inner accent -->
  <polygon points='62,47 70,40 70,60 62,53' fill='#e8487a'/>
  <!-- left wing edge top -->
  <polygon points='47,46 10,30 10,36 47,49' fill='#f78fae'/>
  <!-- right wing edge top -->
  <polygon points='53,46 90,30 90,36 53,49' fill='#f78fae'/>
  <!-- left wing edge bottom -->
  <polygon points='47,54 10,70 10,64 47,51' fill='#8e123b'/>
  <!-- right wing edge bottom -->
  <polygon points='53,54 90,70 90,64 53,51' fill='#8e123b'/>
  <!-- left wing dots -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='45' r='2.2' fill='#ffd9e6'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='50' r='2.2' fill='#ffd9e6'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='55' r='2.2' fill='#ffd9e6'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='47' r='1.8' fill='#ffd9e6'/>
  <!-- right wing dots -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='45' r='2.2' fill='#ffd9e6'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='50' r='2.2' fill='#ffd9e6'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='55' r='2.2' fill='#ffd9e6'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='47' r='1.8' fill='#ffd9e6'/>
  <!-- left wing pinstripes -->
  <line x1='16' y1='40' x2='40' y2='52' stroke='#ff9fbe' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='16' y1='60' x2='40' y2='48' stroke='#ff9fbe' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- right wing pinstripes -->
  <line x1='84' y1='40' x2='60' y2='52' stroke='#ff9fbe' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='84' y1='60' x2='60' y2='48' stroke='#ff9fbe' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- center knot shadow -->
  <rect x='43' y='42' width='14' height='16' rx='3' fill='#5e0f28'/>
  <!-- center knot -->
  <rect x='44' y='43' width='12' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#b8214e'/>
  <!-- center knot highlight -->
  <rect x='45' y='44' width='7' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#f25c8a'/>
  <!-- knot texture lines -->
  <line x1='46' y1='49' x2='54' y2='49' stroke='#e8487a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='45' y1='52' x2='55' y2='52' stroke='#e8487a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='55' x2='54' y2='55' stroke='#e8487a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- knot stud -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='50' r='1.2' fill='#ffd9e6'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='50' r='1.2' fill='#ffd9e6'/>
  <!-- upper left wing tip curl -->
  <ellipse cx='12' cy='34' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#f25c8a' transform='rotate(-20 12 34)'/>
  <!-- upper right wing tip curl -->
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='34' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#f25c8a' transform='rotate(20 88 34)'/>
  <!-- lower left wing tip curl -->
  <ellipse cx='12' cy='66' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#a81d44' transform='rotate(20 12 66)'/>
  <!-- lower right wing tip curl -->
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='66' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#a81d44' transform='rotate(-20 88 66)'/>
</svg>
